images.author: Ron Sasso
images.caption: This is the side of a rare Lustron Newport home that is on the historic register, also referred to as the Cassidy House.

facade.notes: the Cassidy House (a Lustron Newport, 1949-50), side view: a small one-storey house of square porcelain-enamelled steel panels in light blue, a low enamelled steel hip roof, white trim; a later frame garage, a concrete drive

why.note: the Lustron (Columbus OH, 1948-50): a factory-made enamelled-steel house trucked in panels -- the postwar prefab that failed on cost
